channel.title: FORTUNA SIGNAL — Briefs
channel.description: Published research briefs from FORTUNA SIGNAL.

item.title: The five questions behind every dossier
item.description: Every token in the Asset Library is read against the same five questions — the FORA-01 verification standard. Here is what they are, and why the order matters.

item.title: We went looking for 126 whitepapers. 64 tokens didn't have one.
item.description: FORTUNA's research corpus now covers 126 tokens. For 62, we read the official whitepaper. For 64 — including some of the largest names in crypto — no whitepaper exists. A missing primary document is itself a finding.

item.title: When the studio shuts down — what happened to Pirate Nation
item.description: Proof of Play, the a16z-backed studio behind Pirate Nation, shut down in August 2026 and open-sourced the game. The PIRATE token persists under an independent foundation — but the game is no longer a live service.
